message.reasoning:
We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The user asks: "Not sure our automations survive a plan migration cleanly." They want to know about automations during plan migration. The policy says moving a workspace to a new plan does not interrupt existing API keys, webhooks or automation rules—they continue running. Also tier-gated automation features may be paused if not available in destination tier, otherwise activate. Also you can view status in Settings → Automation → Rules before confirming migration.

Thus we can answer: automations continue, no reconfiguration needed; tier-gated features may be paused if not available; you can check status in Automation Rules page before confirming.

We should provide concise answer. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"Your automations will keep running through a plan migration – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier, so no re‑configuration is needed. The only change can be for tier‑gated automation features: if a rule uses a capability that isn’t included in the new tier, the rule will be paused (not deleted) and will reactivate automatically if you later move back to a tier that supports it. You can review the impact before confirming the migration by opening **Settings → Automation → Rules**, which shows the status of every rule and flags any that would be paused."}

arguments.message: Your automations will keep running through a plan migration – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier, so no re‑configuration is needed. The only change can be for tier‑gated automation features: if a rule uses a capability that isn’t included in the new tier, the rule will be paused (not deleted) and will reactivate automatically if you later move back to a tier that supports it. You can review the impact before confirming the migration by opening **Settings → Automation → Rules**, which shows the status of every rule and flags any that would be paused.
